risk_note: RV2 by path (orders, platform/metrics). Taobao rescan goes from one 30-day stream to three tiers, each its own stream, cursor and timer: rescan (30 days, update time, existing cursor), rescan_hour (3 hours, pay time, no start margin, window min(cap, 20 min), 400 s pace) and rescan_week (90 days, pay time, off by default); the rescan window reads order_sync.rescan.taobao.window_minutes (default 180) and drops to at most 20 minutes when order_sync.promo_mode is on; rescan.window carries timeBasis to the Taobao adapter. JD and PDD unchanged. platform/metrics counts rescan and rescan_* as non-watermark streams. No money, ledger, contract or migration change. Three frozen expectations changed under D10-327 in this branch (listed in the PR); the fourth ([AC-B1-04zm#16], green on the skeleton) went in first as the pre test-change #2644 (D10-846, replacing the D10-821 red exception), so rescan/config.test.ts is no longer in this diff.
